text:
ella-support: PulsePay just opened a critical ticket — lots of 504s and 5xx starting ~10:12 UTC. They say timeouts spike for short bursts, affecting checkout flows.
aj-oncall: seeing the alerts. p95 gateway timeout for hosted-inference increased from 120ms -> 1.6s, and 504s showing up in logs.
ben-sre: linking dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/hosted/ingress/queue-depth?from=now-1h to show queue backlog.
ops-bot: ALERT: hosted.gateway.requests.504 rate > threshold (10m window) for tenant=pulsepay : 42 events
support-bot: Customer reported sample request that consistently times out: curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"input":"buy 3 items"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -> 504 after 30s
maya-ml: quick signal from model-side: continuous-batcher backlog length jumped to 28k and dequeue rate dropped ~40% at 10:11 UTC. Possible KV-cache spin-up + long sequences causing batcher head-of-line.
aj-oncall: can someone run a prom query for batcher backlog/queue_depth and per-tenant in-flight?
ben-sre: PromQL snippets I ran: 
```
sum(rate(continuous_batcher_dequeue_total[1m])) by (pool)
sum(continuous_batcher_queue_length) by (tenant)
sum(hosted_gateway_request_queue_depth) by (tenant)
```
results: tenant=pulsepay queue_length=27842, in_flight=1998 (we hit queue depth cap 2000 config)
ella-support: so we're hitting the queue depth limit and new requests are getting early-reject/timeout? Customer saw both 429 and 504s.
maya-ml: config shows per-tenant max_inflight=2000 for hosted tier, we saturated it. Batcher couldn't form good continuous batches because of highly variable seq lengths + some long LLM calls from pulsepay.
aj-oncall: root cause hypothesis: tenant spike (PulsePay) with many long-seq requests + KV-cache coldstart causing batcher enqueuing and hitting depth limit -> gateway holds until timeout -> 504s. Also retry storms from SDK caused amplification.
ben-sre: immediate mitigations: 1) throttle tenant to 30% of baseline traffic via rate-limit rule, 2) route new requests to cold-path (no continuous batching) for that tenant, 3) increase queue_depth soft limit to 3000 for 15m. Which one should we try first?
ella-support: PulsePay wants fastest fix; they can accept degraded throughput. Recommend throttle + route to cold-path. I'll message customer. :phone: @aj-oncall you good to apply?
aj-oncall: applying tenant throttle now. Command: 
```
redwoodctl tenant update-rate-limit --tenant pulsepay --rate 0.3
```
(doing it)
ops-bot: EVENT: rate limit updated for tenant=pulsepay -> 30% applied
ben-sre: also toggling routing to bypass continuous batcher for pulsepay: 
```
redwoodctl route set --tenant pulsepay --policy cold-path
```
aj-oncall: route update done. Confirming metrics... dequeue rate up ~25% within 60s, queue_length falling to 9k. p95 latency started decreasing.
maya-ml: good. For longer-term: we should add per-tenant dynamic batching thresholds and KV-cache prewarm when tenant has many longseq patterns, plus client-side guidance to avoid retries.
ella-support: customer replied: reduced 504s but some 429s still. They're happy for now, want root cause and durable fix.
ben-sre: follow-ups: 1) postmortem to include timeline + config tweaks, 2) add adaptive tenant throttling runbook, 3) patch continuous-batcher to detect queue-depth saturation and proactively shed long-seq heavy requests.
aj-oncall: logging excerpts I pulled: 
```
[10:11:42] batcher enqueue failed: queue_depth=2000 max_inflight=2000 tenant=pulsepay
[10:12:03] gateway backend timeout -> 504 tenant=pulsepay request_id=abc123
[10:12:18] sdk retry attempt=3 client=js-sdk tenant=pulsepay
```
ella-support: customer asked for repro steps. I provided a small curl script they can run that reproduces timeout when they're at previous traffic levels. Please include a safe repro snippet for support ticket (non-production load).
maya-ml: repro (non-destructive): run 50 concurrent requests with varied seq lengths, that'll simulate their burst: 
```
for i in {1..50}; do 
  seq_len=$(( (RANDOM % 200) + 20 ));
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d "{\"input\": \"x\"$seq_len}" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done; wait
```
ben-sre: note in repro you'll see queue_depth climb and early 429/504 once >2000 in_flight. Use staging keys.
aj-oncall: creating incident ticket for follow-up remediation: INC-2026-174321. Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml.
ella-support: customer update posted — they acknowledged mitigation and will keep us posted if they see further spikes. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: SCHEDULED: autoscale suggestion flagged — recommend scaling dedicated pool for hosted tier for pulsepay by +1 GPU for next 30m.
ben-sre: I'll open a short-lived configuration PR to allow temporary increase of max_inflight and add a guard to avoid unbounded retry amplification.
maya-ml: long-term items for roadmap: per-tenant batch shaping, KV prewarm hooks, and SDK guidance to backoff jitter.
ella-support: thanks team. I'll file the support postmortem summary and attach logs/graph links. Marking this thread resolved for now; will reopen if PulsePay reports more 5xxs. :lock:
